response.text: {"intro":"Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams and runs on Bike with 6 apps: Hiring, Onboarding, Time off, Spend, Tools and budgets, and Customer contracts. Each one is a set of sheets, the steps a row moves through, and who can see and do what.","paragraphs":["Fernwood Labs has 14 people in 5 teams: Engineering, Growth, Customer, Operations and People. Every app takes its people from the same list, so a hiring manager, a buddy, a tool owner or a contract owner is always a real person at the company. Two people, Aisha and Leo, have no manager recorded. Requests in Time off go to a person's manager, so this matters for them.","New people start in Hiring. Wade owns it and sees every role. Hiring managers see and run their own roles. Each opening moves from Draft to Open and then to Filled or Closed. Candidates move from Applied through Screen, Interview and Offer to Hired or Rejected. When a candidate moves to Interview, three interviews are added and each interviewer gets a scorecard task. On the day of an interview, an interviewer who has not scored it is asked for the scorecard. An offer above the salary band waits on Wade to approve it. An offer within the band waits on the hiring manager to send it.","When a candidate is Hired, their opening moves to Filled and a plan starts in Onboarding with their name, start date and manager. Priya owns Onboarding. A plan lists a buddy, an IT contact and tasks with owners and due dates. Tasks move from To do to Doing to Done. Priya, Wade and Aisha see every plan. Tools and budgets, owned by Lena, tracks each tool, its vendor, its seats and who holds them, its yearly cost and its renewal date. It also holds each team's budget by quarter.","Spending runs through the Spend app, which Lena owns. Purchases move from Submitted to Approved, then Ordered and Received, or Rejected. Expenses start at Needs a receipt, move to Submitted once the receipt is attached, then to Approved and Paid, or Rejected. Nobody can approve their own purchase or expense. Submitted expenses wait on Lena. Company rules say expenses and contracts over $10,000 need Lena's approval. When an expense has no category, an AI step suggests one and Lena confirms it. Krishna can see and move every purchase.","Revenue is tracked in Customer contracts, which Wade owns. Each contract holds the customer, the yearly value, the start date, the renewal date, the notice period and the signed file. Contracts move from Draft to Signed, Active, Renewal due, and then Renewed or Ended. When a signed PDF is added, an AI step reads it and fills in the row, and the owner confirms it. Sixty days before the notice date, a contract moves to Renewal due and its owner is reminded. Thirty days before, if it is still due, Wade and the owner are told. Wade and Krishna see every contract.","Time off is owned by Lena. People ask for Vacation, Sick or Personal leave. A request can only be added if the days fit within the person's balance. Requests go to the person's manager and move from Submitted to Approved, Declined or Taken. Nobody can approve or decline their own request. When a request is approved or declined, the person and Lena are told. Everyone sees their own balance and their team's requests. No public holidays have been entered yet.","Most work moves by itself from one step to the next. Offers, receipts, renewals and time off requests each wait on a named person, and that person is told when it is their turn. Lena and Wade can see across most apps and change how they work. Every change, made by hand or through Customize, is recorded in the Audit log."],"sentences":[{"capability":"Hiring","sentence":"Holds openings, candidates and interviews; Wade approves offers above the salary band, hiring managers run their roles and send offers, and interviewers score their interviews."},{"capability":"Onboarding","sentence":"Holds a plan for each new hire and its tasks; Priya, Wade and Aisha see every plan, while managers, buddies and task owners work on their own."},{"capability":"Time off","sentence":"Holds leave requests, yearly balances and public holidays; people ask, managers approve or decline, and Lena and Wade see everything."},{"capability":"Spend","sentence":"Holds purchases, their lines and expenses; people submit their own, and Lena approves them with Wade, while Krishna can see and move purchases."},{"capability":"Tools and budgets","sentence":"Holds tools, who has a seat and each team's budget; Lena, Wade and Krishna manage it and everyone else sees nothing."},{"capability":"Customer contracts","sentence":"Holds contracts, renewals and customer contacts; Wade and Krishna see every contract and owners edit and move their own."}],"phrases":[{"connection":"Hiring > Onboarding","phrase":"when someone is hired, their onboarding plan starts with their name, start date and manager"}],"worth":["Offer approval is empty on 13 candidates in Hiring, so it is unclear which offers have been approved or declined.","Category and Paid with are empty on 18 expenses in Spend, which leaves Lena to sort them before they can be reviewed properly.","Aisha and Leo have no manager recorded, so their time off requests have no manager to go to."]}
